chosen.label: CeremonyStartEvent
chosen.definition: An event marking the beginning of a ceremony.
chosen.justification: A championship start can be considered a formal beginning, aligning with the definition of vocab:CeremonyStartEvent.

examples: 2025 US Open mixed doubles championship started

chosen.label: MatchResult
chosen.definition: An event describing the outcome or conclusion of a competitive match.
chosen.justification: No existing candidate represents the *result* of a match; a new event type is minted as a specific kind of SportsEvent.

examples: Errani and Vavassori beat Ruud and Swiatek
